summary.text: Craig A. Hart is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 6, listed with Mingo County; the district covers Mingo, McDowell and Mercer counties and part of Wayne. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hart's page lists his occupation as agriculture teacher and FFA advisor and his religion as Christian.
It lists his affiliations as the NRA, Farm Bureau and WV CDL.
Hart also serves on the Senate's Education, Energy, Industry and Mining, Judiciary, Natural Resources and Transportation and Infrastructure committees.
Between sessions he chairs the interim Agriculture and Rural Development committee.
